post.description:
Full guest ticket purchase sequence:
1. Guest joins the event (matching/join endpoint) — creates an EventJoin with status RESERVED.
2. Call this endpoint with eventId (+ optional discountCode or rewardDiscountId — the final amount already reflects any discount applied). Returns a Stripe clientSecret + paymentIntentId.
3. Client confirms the card payment with Stripe (stripe.confirmCardPayment(clientSecret)).
4. Call POST /payments/confirm with the paymentIntentId. This confirms the EventJoin (RESERVED -> CONFIRMED), creates the Escrow hold, and issues a GuestTicket.
5. The ticket now appears in GET /tickets/my; GET /payments/history shows the payment.
For PayPal instead of Stripe, use POST /payments/paypal/create-order + POST /payments/paypal/capture/{orderId} in place of steps 2-4 — same discount handling, same end result (ticket + escrow).

info.title: Kumele API
info.description:
## Kumele Backend API Documentation
      
      Kumele is a social meetup/hobby matching application - "Tinder for events".
      
      ### Features:
      - User authentication (JWT, Google OAuth, Passkeys)
      - Event creation and management
      - Location-based matching
      - Real-time chat
      - Payment processing (Stripe, PayPal, Crypto)
      - Reward system (Bronze/Silver/Gold badges)
      
      ### Authentication:
      Most endpoints require a Bearer token in the Authorization header.
      Use `/auth/login` or `/auth/signup` to obtain tokens.

password.description: Password (min 8 chars, must include uppercase, lowercase, number)

recaptcha_token.description: Google reCAPTCHA v3 token — send this when reCAPTCHA is enabled in the app

betaCode.description: Beta invite code — required only when beta signup gating is enabled server-side

role.description: User role for role-based routing on the frontend

isOnboardingCompleted.description: Whether the user has completed onboarding (has firstName, avatar, and at least one hobby). If false, redirect to the onboarding flow. If true, go directly to the main app.

emailVerified.description: Whether the user has verified their email address

recaptcha_token.description: Google reCAPTCHA token (v2 or v3). Required when submitted from mobile clients. Verified against Google's siteverify API before authentication proceeds.

password.description: Current account password, required as a confirmation step for accounts that have one (email/password signup). Not required for Google/Firebase-only accounts, which have no local password to check.

idToken.description: Firebase ID token from signInWithPopup/signInWithCredential. This is the field the web app actually sends — either this or firebase_token is required.

firebase_token.description: Same Firebase ID token, alternate field name used by the Flutter/mobile client. Either this or idToken is required.

email.description: Email address to send password reset OTP
Email address the OTP was sent to

otp.description: 6-digit numeric OTP from the reset email

newPassword.description: New password (min 8 chars, must include uppercase, lowercase, and number)
New password (min 8 chars, must include uppercase, lowercase, and number)

device_code.description: Opaque device code returned by POST /auth/device/code

user_code.description: Short user code shown/scanned on the TV

maxUses.description: How many signups this code allows

subtitle.description: Short subtitle / tagline for the event

basePriceEur.description: Price in EUR (required if isPaid is true)

userIds.description: User IDs to check availability for

guestUserId.description: Guest user ID to check in

eventId.description: Event ID to pay for. Exactly one of eventId/nftId is required.

nftId.description: NFT collection ID to pay for (PayPal NFT checkout). Exactly one of eventId/nftId is required.

returnUrl.description: PayPal only — where PayPal sends the browser after the buyer approves payment. Defaults to PAYPAL_RETURN_URL if omitted. Should point at a real page on your domain that calls POST /payments/paypal/capture/:orderId, not a marketing page.

cancelUrl.description: PayPal only — where PayPal sends the browser if the buyer cancels. Defaults to PAYPAL_CANCEL_URL if omitted.

code.description: Authorization code returned by PayPal after user consent

redirectUri.description: The exact redirect_uri used in the initial /connect redirect (must match)

returnUrl.description: Where Stripe sends the host back after completing (or abandoning) onboarding

refreshUrl.description: Where Stripe sends the host if the onboarding link expires or fails — used to restart it

signedTransactionInfo.description: The signedTransactionInfo JWS string from StoreKit (initial purchase, Transaction.updates, or Restore Purchases)

purchaseToken.description: The purchaseToken returned by Google Play Billing after a purchase (initial purchase, PurchasesUpdatedListener callback, or queryPurchases on Restore).

productId.description: The Play Console subscription product id (e.g. "kumele_premium"). The base plan actually purchased is read from the verified Google payload itself, not trusted from the client.

cancelImmediately.description: Cancel immediately or at period end

walletAddress.description: User wallet address (for future on-chain minting)
